documentation-maintenance.llm-instructions:
Before modifying ANY file, you MUST: 1. Read the current file-level docstring 2. Decide if your changes affect the documentation 3. Output your decision in this format:
Documentation Decision: - Update Required: Yes/No - Reason: One clear sentence explaining why/why not - Changes Needed: [If Yes] What needs to be updated
Actions Taken: -If "Yes" above, include the docstring edits in your file edits
documentation-maintenance.update-triggers: Check if your changes involve: - File's main purpose changing - New/modified classes or functions - Changes to what this file uses - Changes to what uses this file

workflow.steps: 1. READ current file-level docstring 2. OUTPUT documentation decision 3. MAKE code changes 4. UPDATE docstring if needed
